To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the fluorescence quench method was developed based on the fluorescence of the hybrid membrane and the fluorescence quench effect of 4-Np.

Mn-doped Zn S QDs capped with MIP were prepared and the hybrid membrane was successfully fabricated onto the quartz substrate, and the hybrid membrane could be used as fluorescence sensor for trace 4-NP.

the Mn-doped Zn quantum dots capped by molecularly imprinted polymers were successfully prepared and the fluorescence of hybrid membrane was quenched by 4-nitropenol(4-Np).The hybrid membrane was stable and could be regenerated by ethanol.The method has been applied to detect trace 2.4-D and 4-NP in the real water sample.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the preparation and application of hybrid membrane containing Mn-doped Zn S quantum dots capped by imprinting polymer for the detection of trace 4-NP.
a novel fluorescence method for the detection of 4-Np based on the fluorescence response of the hybrid membrane.
the fabrication of the hybrid membrane containing QDs and the fluorescence recognition of 4-NPs, which may have potential applications in environmental analysis.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

a new fluorescence method was established for the detection of 4-NPs,and the method has the advantages of high sensitivity,low detection limit,good selectivity and simple operation,which is suitable for environmental monitoring.
the method is a promising way to detect 4-NP in water samples.
the hybrid membrane is a promising candidate for the detection of trace 4-NP.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
Mn-doped Zns QDs capped by MIP can be prepared successfully,which is a good candidate to be used as fluorescence recognition material in environmental monitoring.
a simple and effective method was developed for the fluorescence detection of 4-NPs by using a hybrid membrane as fluorescence sensing element.

the hybrid membrane was synthesized successfully,and the fluorescence response of hybrid membrane to the 4-NP was investigated,and a sensitive,fast and selective method was proposed to detect the trace 4-NP in real water samples.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the hybrid membrane containing Mn-doped Zns QDs and MIP has a high sensitivity and selectivity to detect 4-NP,which can be used in practical applications.
Mn-doped QDs capped by MIP could be used as a fluorescence sensing material for the recognition of 4-NPs.
the fluorescence quench effect of 4-NPs can be used as a sensitive and selective method to detect 4-NPs,and the method can be used for the determination of 4-NPS in real water samples.
